Config.Title: Configuration
Config.Intro: Configure SRU and optional text used in the app output.
Config.SruUrlHint: You can enter a full URL (for example https://alma.example.edu/view/sru/INSTITUTION_CODE) or only the path /view/sru/INSTITUTION_CODE. Leave blank to use the standard Alma SRU endpoint.
Config.SecurityNote: For anonymous SRU, leave username and password empty. If SRU requires authentication, enter both fields.

Errors.Load: The configuration could not be loaded.
Errors.Save: The configuration could not be saved.
